errors.evidence: The description states that the order of the categories is "not strictly descending". The sequence of values from top to bottom is 1, 2, 11, 13, 9, 7, 14, 7, 10, 19, 8. This order is arbitrary and does not resemble a descending trend at all. Using the term "not strictly descending" is misleading as it implies the order is mostly descending with a few exceptions, which is not the case.
